graph_interpretation.title: Multistation synchrony
graph_interpretation.key_message: High peak synchrony, but sparse or non-persistent.
graph_interpretation.reading: The synchrony CSV shows that up to 4 of 5 stations were simultaneously active. The maximum active fraction is 0.8 (80.0%), whereas the mean active fraction is 0.027954 (2.7954%). Synchronized samples represent 2.2442% of the analyzed window, with a maximum synchronized run of 6 sample(s). The temporal structure is classified as 'clustered synchronization episodes'.

graph_interpretation.title: Station-resolved z-scores
graph_interpretation.key_message: The global z-score distribution is moderately elevated.

graph_interpretation.title: Extreme anomaly distribution
graph_interpretation.key_message: Extremes are strongly concentrated in time.

graph_interpretation.caveat: Temporal clustering of extremes is meaningful only when read together with synchrony and z-score summaries.

graph_interpretation.title: Anomaly vs synthetic tidal forcing
graph_interpretation.key_message: The anomaly shows moderate linear tracking of the forcing reference.
graph_interpretation.reading: The forcing CSV was read as a contextual reference. The strongest absolute correlation between candidate anomaly columns and forcing-like columns is 0.643851. The relationship is classified as 'moderate_linear_tracking'. This curve is treated as a smooth reference, not as a prediction signal.
graph_interpretation.caveat: The forcing curve is contextual only. It should not be interpreted as a forecasting input or causal proof.
